rationale: The agent executed order-changing actions (cancels and a return) without any visible confirmation from the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. The agent also did not address the user’s conditional boot exchange request (seeking same size/material only if a cheaper option exists) nor hand off to a human if exchange handling was not supported. Additionally, the agent failed to provide the final requested information on how much money the user can get back today. While the agent appears to have looked up the user via email and retrieved multiple order details, the absence of explicit authentication steps, missing confirmations, unaddressed exchange condition, and lack of final refund amount mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
